messages:
incident-bot: PAGING: metering-heartbeat | severity: P2 | Quiet ledger flutter detected in token emitter service. Pager sent to #oncall.

maya: saw the page, joining. seeing a steady under-report from eu-emitter-2 since 02:05 UTC.

alex: looks like token counts are lower upstream but downstream ledger shows a backlog. possible duplicate suppression?

sophia: quick check: run `curl https://emitter.internal/health` -> returning 200 but emit-rate metric is -15% vs baseline over last 10m.

maya: posting snippet from metrics:```
window: 02:00-02:10 UTC
expected_tokens: 1,234,567
emitted_tokens: 1,173,212
delta: -61,355 (-4.97%)
queues.backlog: 42k
```

oncall-monica: are customers seeing overage flags? billing-alerts shows 3 noisy customers with delayed usage emails.

billing-lead: confirmed — billing pipeline delayed, some monthly overage flags triggered by stale shadow counts. need to pause auto-flagging ASAP.

matt: I can flip the auto-flagging rule off.`/run tools/billing-toggle --auto-flag=false`

finance-team: please delay sending invoices/overage emails until recon is complete. hold outbound notifications. :pray:

alex: suspected root: emitter v2 plumbs a new batching path; KV-cache TTL misapplied causing intermittent drop of small payloads. replication shows eu-emitter-2 hit the path first.

sophia: repro locally with tiny payloads — reproduce delta when batch_size < 8. patch in candidate branch `emit-fix/kv-ttl` that forces batch flush on TTL expiration.

maya: mitigation plan: 1) Pause auto-flagging (billing) — matt 2) Route eu traffic to eu-emitter-1 (smart-router) — alex 3) Kick quick hotfix to emitter v2 to force flush on TTL expiry — sophia 4) Run recon + backfill for missing tokens — maya

oncall-monica: I am handing off to night oncall in 20m. will summarize impact and actions below and ping next oncall.

incident-bot: ACTIONS_LOG: [pause_auto_flagging by matt at 02:18 UTC] [router_reroute eu->eu-emitter-1 by alex at 02:22 UTC] [hotfix deploy candidate to eu-emitter-2 by sophia at 02:31 UTC]

matt: auto-flagging paused. command output: `OK: auto_flag=false`

alex: router reroute completed, traffic shift ~92% to eu-emitter-1. monitoring now.

sophia: deployed hotfix to eu-emitter-2 (canary). logs show flush triggers firing immediately.

maya: recon job started: `recon/backfill --source=eu-emitter-2 --since=02:00 --dest=ledger` estimated run time 12m.

oncall-monica: handoff note for next oncall (monica -> jasper): impact: partial undercount (~5%) for EU emitter starting ~02:05; customer-facing overage emails may have started for 3 accounts; billing auto-flagging paused; backfill in progress; hotfix deployed to eu-emitter-2 canary; router reroute in place. escalate to billing if flags persist after backfill.

incident-bot: UPDATE: recon job completed at 02:44 UTC. reconciled 61,412 tokens. delta closed.

maya: confirmed ledger matches expected after backfill. run `select sum(tokens) from ledger where ts between '02:00' and '02:10'` -> 1,234,579 (within +/- 12).

billing-lead: re-running flagging heuristics now against reconciled data.

incident-bot: ACTIONS_LOG: [recon_backfill completed by maya at 02:44 UTC] [resume_auto_flagging scheduled by billing-lead at 02:48 UTC]

matt: resuming auto-flagging now. command output: `OK: auto_flag=true`

finance-team: releasing hold on notifications. sending delayed notices with note: "We delayed a small set of overage notifications while we reconciled usage data."

jasper: joining as next oncall. thanks for the handoff note. all checks green from my side.

matt: closing thread after 02:50 UTC if no further regressions. :white_check_mark:
